faq_heading: Homes near Frost Road Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Frost Road Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Frost Road Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Frost Road Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Frost Road Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 141 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,400,000, townhomes $745,500, condos $510,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Frost Road Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Frost Road Elementary the median was 26 days on the market, closing at 97.2% of the list price, with 10% of sales above the list price for the 141 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Frost Road Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Holy Cross Regional High School (0.5 km north), St Matthew's Elementary (0.6 km north-west) and Surrey Christian School (0.6 km north).

Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Frost Road Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Frost Road Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Frost Road Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Frost Road Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 141 homes sold within 1 km of Frost Road Elementary: 19 houses, 88 townhomes and 33 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $745,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Frost Road Elementary

15 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Frost Road Elementary in a straight line (10 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is Holy Cross Regional High School, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is William F. Davidson Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is St Matthew's Elementary (0.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Coast Meridian Elementary (1.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: St Matthew's Elementary (0.6 km north-west), Walnut Road Elementary (0.8 km south), Woodland Park Elementary (1.2 km north-west), William Watson Elementary (1.4 km south), Coast Meridian Elementary (1.5 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is St Matthew's Elementary, 0.6 km north-west of Frost Road Elementary.
